notes.title: Lycanthorn 2 Omega Update
notes.content:
Lycanthorn 2 Changelog:
-Options Menu streamlined
-Improved intro and font
-Better tutorial
-Music fades when transitioning Day/Night Cycle
-General bug fixes
-Optimizations
-Balance Changes
-Ending improved
-Visual and Game Feel improvements
-Music Properly loops

Lycanthorn 1
-A Whole extra episode of a modified version of Lycanthorn 1 has been added
-Modified Rain character that uses Lycanthorn 2's Rain Actor
-Improved AI from Lycanthorn 2 enemies replace Lycanthorn 1's enemies
-Includes all the original levels, music, and bosses.
-Some very minor balance changes and enemy placements.
